title_zh: 承认打破花瓶并约定归还碎片

scenario.label_zh: 承认打破花瓶并约定归还碎片
scenario.goal_zh: 向朋友坦白损坏花瓶，听取物主要求并约定保留碎片等待共同处理

context_zh: 朋友之间谈论借用房间时意外打破花瓶的事情。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: I have a confession to make. I knocked over your blue vase yesterday, and it broke.

sentences.speaker: Alma
sentences.text: You were here when I asked what had happened. Why did you say nothing?

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: I was embarrassed. I tried to conceal the damage by moving the pieces into a box, but my conscience wouldn't let me leave it there.

sentences.speaker: Alma
sentences.text: I can't compel you to be honest with me. I do need you to tell me when something of mine gets damaged.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: You're right. I'm sorry. I kept all the pieces. Would you like me to bring the box back?

sentences.speaker: Alma
sentences.text: Yes. Please don't throw anything away or try to glue it. We'll look at it together.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: I'll bring the box this evening and leave it as it is.
